source: EV-RealPhys (Kandukuri et al. 2023, MPI, CC BY-SA 4.0), real split
paper_reference_protocol: different protocol: RGB-D online tracking and filtering; not a same-input baseline

inputs.video_tracking_start: mocap rest position projected into the image (replaces user click)
inputs.video_object_height: median mocap centre height of last five frames
inputs.log: mocap centre positions, segmented with the same release/launch estimator as video
inputs.baseline_protocol: same positive-quadratic-fit training pool for Tether and baselines; full Tether estimates separately; held-out push removed before common training eligibility
inputs.measurement_error_model: Both hand-launched benchmark paths use the default video prior: 1% shared scale, 1.5% shared speed, 3 mm stop jitter; not independently measured sensor noise.
